note: Missions whose bot run does not pass on the sf bake yet (M05c1). check:missions prints each as KNOWN GAP and does not run it; DV_RUN_KNOWN_GAPS=1 runs it anyway, and a gap that passes is reported so that its row can be deleted. A row names why and what closes it. The missions themselves are playable and compile clean; the gap is the autoplayer, or the world under it, not the IR.
